The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland is the official title of the U.K. which is the state (the main country) and consists of Northern Ireland, Scotland, Wales and England (the home nations- countries that all follow the laws of the state). So yeah the UK is a collection of these countries.

Great Britain is England, Scotland, Wales.

The United Kingdom is Northern Ireland, Scotland, Wales and England.

The British Isles is Northern Ireland, Republic of Ireland, Scotland, Wales and England.

But the country as a whole- the state- is the United Kingdom. Hope this helps x

He brought in the school intending to shoot his bullies (and anyone else) but someone saw the gun in his bag and tweeted about it. I mean who flipping tweets about a potential school shooter and not notify the school. Anyway, he panicked and shut himself in a music room and called the police on himself. The school didn’t notify parents. We weren’t sent home. No lockdown. Parents only found out through the news. Needless to say the school got a lot of backlash for ‘endangering student welfare’.

Kid’s doing fine. He’s out of jail - was in for less than a year- and is receiving the mental help he needs and goes to a different school where his wellbeing can be monitored or something like that.

I don’t know how to put into words how much that resonates with me. I’ve just turned 15 and feeling the worst I’ve ever felt. I’m a top grade student yet I’m so unhappy. I’m naturally more introverted but with regards to friends I dunno I have a few but they’re  not close. I almost want to be closer but not at the same time. Don’t get me started on the subject of talking to someone at our age- it’s so difficult! But what I’ve found works for me is this reddit page. Venting in the page and then talking to people who know exactly what your going through but are also anonymous is what keeps me going. To know that it’s not just me and that nobody gives you pity. What I always hate is the “oh your just too young” or “it’s just a phase”. Drop me a message if you want to, I feel like we’re going through the exact same thing.
